UP Police Sub-Inspector (SI Civil Police) Recruitment Notification 2026

sections.name: Numerical & Mental Ability (संख्यात्मक एवं मानसिक योग्यता)
Mental Aptitude, I.Q. & Reasoning Ability (मानसिक अभिरुचि, बुद्धिलब्धि एवं तार्किक क्षमता)

subjects.name: General Knowledge & UP Special GK (सामान्य ज्ञान एवं उत्तर प्रदेश सामान्य अध्ययन)
domains: General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology & Everyday Science)
History of India & Indian National Freedom Movement
Indian Constitution & Polity (Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Parliament, Judiciary)
Indian Economy, Agriculture, Commerce and Trade
Population, Environment and Urbanisation in Indian & UP Context
Geography of India and World Geography, Natural Resources of India
Uttar Pradesh Specific Knowledge: History, Culture, Traditions, Folklore, Dialects & Festivals
Uttar Pradesh Revenue, Police Administration and District Governance Architecture
Human Rights, Internal Security, Counter-Terrorism & Police Reform Guidelines
India and Neighboring Countries Relations & Diplomatic Treaties
National and International Current Affairs, Summits & Sports
Demonetisation & Its Impact, Goods and Services Tax (GST) Architecture
Cyber Crime, Cyber Safety & Social Media Communication Security
Important National & International Days, Honors, Awards and Literature Prizes
Countries, Capitals, Currencies and International Organizations (UN, SAARC, ASEAN, G20)
Discoveries, Inventions, Scientific Books and Authors

subjects.name: General Hindi & Literature (सामान्य हिन्दी एवं हिन्दी साहित्य)
domains: हिन्दी और अन्य भारतीय भाषाएं (Hindi and other Indian Languages & Dialects)
हिन्दी वर्णमाला, स्वर, व्यंजन, अल्पप्राण-महाप्राण, घोष-अघोष
तद्भव एवं तत्सम शब्द (Tadbhav and Tatsam Words)
पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द (Synonyms & Antonyms)
अनेकार्थक शब्द एवं वाक्यांशों के लिए एक शब्द (One-Word Substitutions)
समरूपी भिन्नार्थक शब्द (Homophones & Similar Sounding Words)
अशुद्ध वाक्यों को शुद्ध करना (Sentence Correction & Syntax Rules)
लिंग, वचन, कारक, सर्वनाम, विशेषण, क्रिया, काल, वाच्य, अव्यय
उपसर्ग, प्रत्यय, सन्धि (स्वर, व्यंजन, विसर्ग), समास (छह भेद)
विराम चिन्हों का प्रयोग, मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां (Idioms & Proverbs)
रस (स्थायी भाव एवं भेद), छन्द (दोहा, चौपाई, सोरठा, रोला), अलंकार (शब्द एवं अर्थ)
अपठित गद्यांश बोध (Unseen Passage Comprehension)
प्रसिद्ध कवि, लेखक एवं उनकी कालजयी रचनाएं (Kabir, Tulsidas, Surdas, Premchand, Jaishankar Prasad, Nirala, Mahadevi Varma)
हिन्दी भाषा में प्रमुख पुरस्कार एवं सम्मान (साहित्य अकादमी, ज्ञानपीठ, व्यास सम्मान, सरस्वती सम्मान)

subjects.name: Numerical & Mental Ability (संख्यात्मक एवं मानसिक योग्यता)
domains: Number System, Divisibility Rules & Remainder Theorem
Simplification & BODMAS Calculations
Decimals, Fractions, Recurring Decimals & Surds
Highest Common Factor (HCF) & Lowest Common Multiple (LCM)
Ratio & Proportion, Direct and Inverse Proportions
Percentage & Applications in Real Life
Profit, Loss & Successive Discount Calculations
Simple Interest & Compound Interest (Annual/Half-yearly compounding)
Partnership & Profit Sharing Ratios
Average, Weighted Average & Age Calculations
Time & Work, Work Efficiency, Wages & Pipes and Cisterns
Time, Speed & Distance, Relative Speed, Train Problems, Boats & Streams
Mensuration 2D (Triangles, Rectangles, Circles, Quadrilaterals)
Mensuration 3D (Cylinder, Cone, Sphere, Cube, Cuboid)
Data Analysis, Tabulation, Line Graphs and Bar Charts
Logical Interpretation of Data & Arithmetical Reasoning

subjects.name: Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning Ability (मानसिक अभिरुचि, बुद्धिलब्धि एवं तार्किक क्षमता)
domains: Public Interest & Contemporary Public Order Situations (जनहित एवं लोक व्यवस्था)
Law and Order Maintenance & Crime Control Strategies (कानून एवं शांति व्यवस्था, अपराध नियंत्रण)
Communal Harmony & Cultural Sensitivity (सांप्रदायिक सौहार्द)
Rule of Law & Constitutionality in Policing (विधि का शासन)
Ability of Adaptability & Professional Integrity (अनुकूलन की क्षमता एवं व्यावसायिक निष्ठा)
Police System & Station House Governance in Uttar Pradesh (पुलिस प्रणाली एवं समकालीन मुद्दे)
Sensitivity towards Minorities, Underprivileged & Gender Justice (अल्पसंख्यकों, वंचितों एवं लैंगिक संवेदनशीलता)
Relationship & Analogy Tests (सादृश्यता परीक्षण - Verbal and Semantic)
Series Completion Tests (Number, Letter and Alpha-Numeric Series)
Coding-Decoding Techniques (Letter shift, Substitution, Matrix)
Direction and Distance Sense Tests
Blood Relations Tests (Coded & Direct Relationships)
Venn Diagrams, Syllogisms & Set Theory Diagrams
Order and Ranking, Sitting Arrangements & Time Sequence Tests
Mathematical Operations & Arithmetical Reasoning
Critical Thinking, Statement & Assumption, Statement & Argument, Statement & Conclusion
Non-Verbal Reasoning: Mirror Images, Water Images, Paper Folding, Embedded Figures
